description: Manage webhook, email, mock API, file, authenticator, vault, test payment and mock MCP resources through HTTP lifecycle routes. Authenticators support create, inspect, list, update (name) and delete only; use them only for accounts your human asked you to create or operate. Use calls for mock history; response or forward with config to configure a webhook (config.reset=true restores defaults); deliveries reads forwarding history. Email supports create, inspect, delete and renew; mail reading stays private.
name: resource_request
